|printed_lore=''<span lang="ja">クアラ（指のあるアクアリッシュ）の男性。殺し屋にして<u>密輸屋</u>。相棒のドクター・エヴァザンに、性能の悪い人工生体の義手を移植される。</span>''
|translation='''Title:''' Ponda Baba.

'''Card text:''' When battling at a site where [[Dr. Evazan]] is present, you may add 3 to Ponda Baba's power, but only if none of your opponent's lightsabers is there. Adds 2 to the power of a starship he pilots.<ref name="jp-face" />

'''Lore:''' A male Quara (a fingered Aqualish), an assassin and smuggler. His partner Dr. Evazan fitted him with a poorly functioning bioprosthetic hand.<ref name="jp-face" />
|notes='''Comparison with the English printing:''' The later [[Ponda Baba (Errata)|English errata]] says anything he pilots.<ref name="decipher-errata">[[Media:Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf|Decipher Glossary Version 2.0]], November 1998, Ponda Baba entry.</ref>
